steps.npc: Can I help you at all?

options.text: Yes please. What are you selling?
I'm in search of a man named Avan Fitzharmon.

steps.player: I'm in search of a man named Avan Fitzharmon.

steps.npc: Can't say as I've seen him... I'm sure if he's been to Al-Kharid recently someone around here will have though.

options.text: What do you think of Ali Morrisane?

steps.player: What do you think of Ali Morrisane?

steps.npc: I don't trust him, not after he's sent his men round to threaten us.
Did you know, we've had four different thugs come round and threaten us if we don't join them.
I've had hammers, rakes, swords and even scissors waved at me!

steps.player: What will you do about it?

steps.npc: We'll carry on as normal with the store. Business as usual!
Can I interest you in anything?
